types.name: collab.v1.ArchiveBoardRequest
types.doc: ArchiveBoardRequest archives or unarchives a board.

fields.name: board_id
fields.doc: Board identifier as a UUID string.

fields.name: archived
fields.doc: Target archive state. True archives the board, false restores it.

types.name: collab.v1.ArchiveBoardResponse
types.doc: ArchiveBoardResponse returns the updated archive state.

fields.name: board
fields.doc: Updated board metadata.

fields.name: access
fields.doc: Resolved caller access.

types.name: collab.v1.Board
types.doc: Board is the persisted metadata for a collaborative whiteboard.

fields.name: board_id
fields.doc: Stable board identifier as a UUID string.

fields.name: owner_account_id
fields.doc: Board owner account public ID.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Human-readable board title, max 200 characters and 400 bytes.

fields.name: audience
fields.doc: Default audience policy used when no explicit ACL entry matches.

fields.name: default_role
fields.doc: Default role granted by the audience policy. This is always VIEWER or EDITOR.

fields.name: access_version
fields.doc: Monotonic access version incremented when audience, default role, ACL, or archive state changes.

fields.name: initial_snapshot
fields.doc: Optional initial document snapshot as a JSON object.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Creation time in UTC.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Last update time in UTC.

fields.name: archived_at
fields.doc: Archive time in UTC. Unset when the board is active.

types.name: collab.v1.BoardAccess
types.doc:
BoardAccess is the resolved caller access for a board.
 Access resolution prefers owner, explicit user ACL, explicit group ACL, then audience policy.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Highest resolved role for the caller.

fields.name: permissions
fields.doc: Expanded permission flags for the caller.

types.name: collab.v1.BoardAclEntry
types.doc: BoardAclEntry grants a role to one explicit ACL subject.

fields.name: subject_type
fields.doc: Subject domain for the ACL row.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.doc: Subject public ID. For USER_SUBJECT this is an account ID; for GROUP_SUBJECT this is a group ID.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Granted role for the subject. Only VIEWER and EDITOR are valid ACL roles.

types.name: collab.v1.BoardAclSubjectType
types.doc: BoardAclSubjectType identifies the explicit ACL subject domain.

values.name: USER_SUBJECT
values.doc: ACL entry applies to one account.

values.name: GROUP_SUBJECT
values.doc: ACL entry applies to one collaboration group.

types.name: collab.v1.BoardAudience
types.doc: BoardAudience controls which audience rule applies when no explicit ACL entry matches.

values.name: PRIVATE
values.doc: Only the owner and explicit ACL entries have access.

values.name: PUBLIC
values.doc: Any caller gets the board default role.

values.name: FOLLOWERS
values.doc: Followers of the owner get the board default role.

types.name: collab.v1.BoardListItem
types.doc: BoardListItem is one visible board plus the caller's resolved access.

fields.name: board
fields.doc: Board metadata.

fields.name: access
fields.doc: Resolved access for the current caller.

types.name: collab.v1.BoardPermissions
types.doc: BoardPermissions is the resolved permission set for the caller.

fields.name: can_view
fields.doc: Whether the caller may view metadata and join the room.

fields.name: can_edit
fields.doc: Whether the caller may edit board content in the room.

fields.name: can_manage
fields.doc: Whether the caller may manage sharing and board settings.

types.name: collab.v1.BoardRole
types.doc: BoardRole is the resolved capability level for a caller on a board.

values.name: VIEWER
values.doc: Viewer can read board metadata and join the room as read-only.

values.name: EDITOR
values.doc: Editor can view and edit board content in the room.

values.name: OWNER
values.doc: Owner can view, edit, archive, and manage sharing settings.

types.name: collab.v1.CreateBoardRequest
types.doc: CreateBoardRequest creates a new board owned by the caller.

cel.message: title must contain at least one non-whitespace character
acl_entries must not contain duplicate subjects

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Board title, max 200 characters and 400 bytes.

fields.name: audience
fields.doc: Initial audience policy for the board.

fields.name: default_role
fields.doc: Default audience role for callers admitted by PUBLIC or FOLLOWERS audience policy.

fields.name: acl_entries
fields.doc: Optional explicit ACL entries created with the board, max 256 entries.

fields.name: initial_snapshot
fields.doc: Optional initial document snapshot as a JSON object.

types.name: collab.v1.CreateBoardResponse
types.doc: CreateBoardResponse returns the created board and resolved caller access.

fields.name: board
fields.doc: Created board metadata.

fields.name: acl_entries
fields.doc: Stored explicit ACL entries ordered by creation time, subject type, then subject ID.

fields.name: access
fields.doc: Resolved caller access for the board.

types.name: collab.v1.GetBoardRequest
types.doc: GetBoardRequest loads one board by ID.

fields.name: board_id
fields.doc: Board identifier as a UUID string.

types.name: collab.v1.GetBoardResponse
types.doc: GetBoardResponse returns one visible board.

fields.name: board
fields.doc: Board metadata.

fields.name: acl_entries
fields.doc: Explicit ACL entries ordered by creation time, subject type, then subject ID. Returned only for callers who can manage the board.

fields.name: access
fields.doc: Resolved caller access.

types.name: collab.v1.ListBoardsRequest
types.doc: ListBoardsRequest lists boards visible to the caller.

fields.name: include_archived
fields.doc: When true, include archived boards in the response.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of boards to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted; maximum
 is 500.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated caller, archive filter, and newest-updated sort
 order.

types.name: collab.v1.ListBoardsResponse
types.doc: ListBoardsResponse lists boards visible to the caller in most-recently-updated order.

fields.name: boards
fields.doc: Visible boards ordered by updated_at descending, then board_id descending.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: collab.v1.MintJoinTokenRequest
types.doc: MintJoinTokenRequest resolves access and mints a short-lived room admission token.

fields.name: board_id
fields.doc: Board identifier as a UUID string.

types.name: collab.v1.MintJoinTokenResponse
types.doc: MintJoinTokenResponse returns the signed room admission contract for the caller.

fields.name: board_id
fields.doc: Board identifier as a UUID string.

fields.name: access
fields.doc: Resolved caller access for the board.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Token expiry time in UTC. Join tokens expire 5 minutes after issuance.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Signed short-lived room admission token.

fields.name: room_id
fields.doc: Room identifier the client should join. This is the board ID.

fields.name: connection_id
fields.doc: Unique connection identifier embedded in the token.

fields.name: socket_path
fields.doc: Realtime room URL the client should connect to.

fields.name: presence
fields.doc: Lightweight local presence payload for the caller.

fields.name: access_version
fields.doc: Access version embedded in the token; clients must refresh when the board access version changes.

types.name: collab.v1.PresencePayload
types.doc: PresencePayload is a lightweight identity payload the client can reuse locally.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Caller account public ID.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Resolved board role for this join.

types.name: collab.v1.UpdateBoardAclRequest
types.doc: UpdateBoardAclRequest fully replaces the explicit ACL for a board.

cel.message: acl_entries must not contain duplicate subjects

fields.name: board_id
fields.doc: Board identifier as a UUID string.

fields.name: acl_entries
fields.doc: Full replacement ACL set for the board, max 256 entries. Existing ACL entries are replaced atomically.

types.name: collab.v1.UpdateBoardAclResponse
types.doc: UpdateBoardAclResponse returns the updated board and ACL state.

fields.name: board
fields.doc: Updated board metadata.

fields.name: acl_entries
fields.doc: Stored ACL entries after replacement, ordered by creation time, subject type, then subject ID.

fields.name: access
fields.doc: Resolved caller access.

types.name: collab.v1.UpdateBoardRequest
types.doc: UpdateBoardRequest updates mutable board metadata.

cel.message: at least one mutable field must be provided
title must contain at least one non-whitespace character

fields.name: board_id
fields.doc: Board identifier as a UUID string.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: New board title, max 200 characters and 400 bytes. When unset, the title is unchanged.

fields.name: audience
fields.doc: New audience policy. When unset, the audience is unchanged.

fields.name: default_role
fields.doc: New default audience role for PUBLIC or FOLLOWERS access. When unset, the role is unchanged.

fields.name: initial_snapshot
fields.doc: New initial snapshot as a JSON object. When unset, the snapshot is unchanged.

types.name: collab.v1.UpdateBoardResponse
types.doc: UpdateBoardResponse returns the updated board.

fields.name: board
fields.doc: Updated board metadata.

fields.name: acl_entries
fields.doc: Explicit ACL entries ordered by creation time, subject type, then subject ID. Returned only for callers who can manage the board.

fields.name: access
fields.doc: Resolved caller access.
